scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run compile && npm run viewer:build
scripts.print:calibration: npm run compile --silent && node build/app/apps/cli/src/main.js calibrate --profile profiles/prusa-xl-5t.json --output build/print/prusa-xl-calibration.3mf --manifest build/print/prusa-xl-calibration.json
scripts.print:connector-comparison: npm run compile --silent && node build/app/apps/cli/src/main.js compare-connectors --profile profiles/prusa-xl-5t.json --output build/print/dependency-connector-comparison.3mf --instructions build/print/dependency-connector-comparison.instructions.txt
scripts.print:demo: npm run compile --silent && node build/app/apps/cli/src/main.js export --model examples/demo-city.json --profile profiles/prusa-xl-5t.json --format 3mf --scale 3 --labels auto --routes auto --legend build/print/code-city-demo.legend.json --output build/print/code-city-demo.3mf
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run docs:build
